title: Absolute preview tags
summary: Every page gets an absolute og:image and twitter:image (https://ai100.appwrite.network/og.png) and its own absolute og:url (/, /hra/<date>, /archiv, /obsazeni, /vlastni/<id>). The base URL comes from VITE_SITE_URL with the production domain as default.
tradeoffs: The domain is baked in at build time; a different domain needs VITE_SITE_URL set for the build. Nothing visible changes on the page.
